items.text: ETR listed Breece Hall as GTD/PESSIMISM pregame; Schefter confirmed INACTIVE for Jets.
items.why: Weekend injury reports and official inactives
items.implication: No fantasy production Week 7; monitor return timeline and handcuff role

items.text: ETR GTD/OPTIMISM on Puka Nacua (calf); Rapoport confirmed officially ACTIVE.
items.why: Optimism path and official active designation
items.implication: Full or near-full routes/targets expected despite calf
Huntley starts; Ravens offense efficiency drop
items.opportunity: Zay Flowers YPRR elite even with Huntley; upgrade path on Lamar return

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks both OUT.
items.implication: Eagles WR targets redistribute (slot heavy); Lemon/others elevated short-term

items.text: Saquon Barkley ACTIVE vs Cowboys; post-game said hamstring came out great and back issue won't keep him out.
items.why: Official active + player comments on hamstring/back
items.implication: Cleared short-term; monitor practice for lingering effects

items.text: Jonah Coleman (first game back) led Broncos RB snaps 50%, rush share 41%, routes 34%. Dobbins only 21%; Harvey fluky TD.
items.why: Immediate lead snap/rush/route shares on return
items.implication: Coleman priority waiver/flex; Dobbins/Harvey downgraded roles
items.opportunity: Coleman early-down + pass-game expansion; reverse prior handcuff assumptions

items.text: Cam Skattebo actually hurt (hamstring) but uncertain severity; also noted as purposeful slide attempt.
items.implication: Monitor practice; possible reduced snaps or miss
items.opportunity: Tracy or backups elevate if out

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs ankle turned on purposeful slide but almost certainly fine; would have been tilting if actually injured avoiding TD.
items.implication: No expected missed time or reduced role

items.text: Josh Jacobs listed IN and activated/expected to play; Schefter confirmed among actives.
items.implication: Immediate RB workload return for Packers; ROS value solid

items.text: Zay Flowers leads NFL YPRR despite 64% targets from Huntley; Ravens 6th YPP even with Huntley 50% snaps. Very excited for Doyle/Flowers with healthy Lamar.
items.implication: Massive ceiling boost on Lamar return; start with confidence now

items.text: Can we PLEASE put some respect on Tee Higgins’ name?
items.opportunity: Maintain high target/red-zone share with Burrow

items.text: Ashton Jeanty epitome of high-value touch thesis: worst runner metrics (53/59 EPA, last in YPC 3.1) yet fantasy RB13 PPR via 9 carries inside-5 and 45 targets (leads RBs).
items.why: Inside-5 carries + target volume sustain production despite inefficiency
items.implication: Sustainable RB2/flex via opportunity not efficiency; fade pure rushing props

items.text: Tony Pollard exploded Sunday; if you can sell-high on the big game in fantasy, take it.
items.implication: Trade value peak; underlying role/usage may not sustain

items.text: Texans routes on 29 Stroud dropbacks: Nico Collins 24 lead, Tank Dell only 6 in first game back (limited), Noel 15 (left turf toe).
items.implication: Nico remains clear alpha; Dell ramp-up slow, limited immediate threat
